"Automatically cut logs and planks! This resizable bandsaw is perfect for any automated cutting you may want to do! Warning: Keep limbs out of reach."

The bandsaw is an item purchased from Dugg's Digging for $35,000 $10,000. It can automatically cut planks, and be resized to fit larger or smaller trees - with maximum size of 20x20. Much like other machines, it can be moved around in the Property Management menu. When turned on, the Bandsaw will make several cuts into the wood (or player, if you stand in its way, which deal about 20 hp/s) until the wood is removed or the bandsaw is turned off. Bandsaw's damage is fairly weak compared to a normal axe, making chopping huge wood like Sequoia relatively slow. Consider buying multiple bandsaw in a row to make efficiency in time.
